name: Lake Oconee / Greensboro KOA Holiday
evidence: Official KOA site map (2025) draws sites 1-12 in a row lakeward of Lake Shore Dr directly on the shore; KOA sells 'Patio Lake Front' 30A FHU bookable at 23 ft (one plain back-in type caps 19 ft). Satellite 0.33 m/px: pads under trees, clearings ~25-35 m from shore, canopy partly hides them, no contradiction. L13/L14 look long-term, not counted.

name: McIntosh Reserve Park
evidence: County publishes no campsite map; ~50 primitive sites 'throughout the park', not located. Satellite d=0.008: open field on NE bank with a riparian tree strip screening the Chattahoochee. Nothing counting places an RV site on the river. Stored pin falls in the river but no coord_fix without located sites.

name: Paulk Park RV Campground
evidence: Kept on --AWH firsthand note. My reading, satellite 0.33 m/px: pull-through rows in a gravel loop, east ends ~40-65 m and west ends ~100 m from shore across open unused lawn plus the campground's loop road, no treeline. Pin ~200 m north of the loop, under the move threshold.

name: McKaskey Creek Campground
evidence: Sites 14 (25 ft), 16 (24 ft) earn it: legacy rec.gov 232638 per-site Lakefront flags + county WebTrac WF tags + rec.gov site photos: 16 has a boat tied at the shore ~10-15 m behind the table, 14 water through trees ~20-30 m. Pine canopy blinds satellite, no contradiction. 3, 12, 13, 43, 44 under 23 ft don't count; 48/49 tags unsupported (no water near).

name: Whispering Pines Campground
evidence: Operator per-site map draws sites 1-24 backing onto Hemptown Creek; OSM centreline runs ~34.8885-34.8889 just south of the trailer rows (pin ~100 m north); operator photo shows mown bank at the stream. Satellite canopy-blind, no contradiction; stored 'no river in frame' was canopy. Site lengths unstated ('RVs of all sizes'), phone booking.

name: Southern Retreat RV Park
evidence: Satellite 0.33 m/px: stocked pond ~70x50 m just east of the Premier concrete lot; easternmost back-in row ends ~10-15 m from the pond edge across open sandy apron, no road or treeline between (stored evidence wrong). 15 'Premier Back-Ins (Water View)' 30x70 ft bookable nightly on BookMySites.

name: River Junction - Lake Seminole
evidence: Rec.gov 10404059 tags all 11 sites Lakefront including site 6 ~120 m inland, so facility-wide. Satellite with site points: shoreward 7-10 ~40-60 m from water through continuous wooded belt, every Wayback frame 2015-2026. Rec.gov Aug 2026 photos of 1, 3, 5-10: grass/thicket, no water visible anywhere. Leaf-off sightline unconfirmed. Site 11 coordinate is bad.

name: Shoal Creek Campground
evidence: Campspot per-site map: 31 Lake-front W/E RV sites along the shore, ~28 take 23 ft+ (shortest 20-22 ft don't count). Leaf-off Wayback 2026-03 0.49 m/px: RV on a pad in the east lobe ~14 m from the beach top, ~27 m from drawn-down waterline, confirming the row. Pin was in the north tent lobe, ~570 m off; moved to that pad. Finger rows not matched on imagery.
